dog.description_text:
Cocoa is a sweet girl who has previously lived with other dogs, cats, and even a bird! She's looking to go home for the holidays, and would love to find her furrrever family as soon as possible. Come meet and take her home today!

If this animal is located at our Manhattan or Westhampton Adoption Centers, head in to meet them and see if you are a match! We are a same-day adoption center, and an application does not put you on a list or hold an animal for you. If this animal is in Wantagh or in a foster home, please submit an online application and our team will reach out to further discuss the adoption process. Prior to adoption, all of our animals are spayed/neutered, microchipped, and given their age-appropriate vaccines.
